title: Help Me

replies.author: Fouled
replies.body:
Hello,

The reason I perm banned you was because of "prior". After you got banned a few months ago for excessive infractions, you appealed recently and your infraction was lifted. You were warned by the senior staff member that appealed you, stating that if you continue with your past attitude, you will be banned once again with no chance of being appealed. While you were on the server a few days ago, you were constantly swearing and attempting to team spleef. I banned you because you did not learn from your past mistakes, hence "prior".

And about 5 minutes ago, I received these pokes from you.



And there were a lot more pokes, these are just a few.
This also proves that you have not learned from your past mistakes and you continue to be rude towards others.

Because of this, I will be moving your infraction back from a 30 day tempban to a perm ban.

Regards,
Fouled
